about_the_game:
This demo contains 2 levels showcasing the game's features and a vertical slice of the full game's content!

Dive into a surreal speed-fishing odyssey that defies reality. In this unique blend of high-speed boating and unconventional fishing mechanics, you'll harness the power of fish to propel your vessel through dreamlike waters.​

Key Features:

  • A unique Speed-Boat Speed-Fishing Experience: The fish is moving fast, so keep up the speed and evade obstacles while casting the rod into the water!

  • Time-Attack Fish-Attack Stages: The fish will not give up that easily, don't lose control and be quick because they won't wait for you.

  • Weirdo Fish-like Creatures of the Deep Seas: These waters are filled with a bunch of weird creatures that behave like fish. Why are they like this? What purpose do they serve? All that bothers you is that they act like fish and react to bait like fish, so that means you MUST catch them all!

  • Fish-Powered boat engine: Cast your rod to catch a powerful fish that will pull your boat, becoming a fish-engine, control the direction by pulling the fishing rod into desired direction and hope that the fish won't outpower you!

  • Double Fishing Rods, Double Fishing Catch: Two hands means two fishing rods - while controlling the boat with one rod, you can cast with a second one to catch fish that tags alongside and increase your total haul.

  • Spear-Fishing Fish-Diving: Attach yourself to the boat with a rope, let the Fish-Engine take the wheel and dive underwater to meet face-to-face with the fishes and catch them with a spear.

  • A surreal dream-like world: The world around you feels like a surreal fever dream. At first glance, the environments might look mostly ordinal to you, but the closer you look and the further you go, the more unusual, reality-breaking anomalies you encounter. What will you see in the next area? What fish will test your strength next?
